content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Platform stripe

Stripes offers a payment processing service that integrates with various platforms, allowing creators to sell digital products worldwide. However, it operates in only 46 countries, leaving many creators without access. PayPal, on the other hand, provides a broader range of services, including online payments and money transfers. Yet, its account suspension policies can hold funds for up to 180 days, and it also has limited international support. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy are other alternatives, but they have their own set of limitations, such as transaction fees and restricted countries. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), offers a complete digital commerce solution that includes hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, giving creators full control and ownership of their infrastructure.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal have restrictions in place for various countries, often due to regulatory compliance issues or high-risk activities. In these restricted countries, creators are left without access to these platforms, forcing them to find alternative solutions. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also have limited international support, often requiring creators to use workarounds or third-party services. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, is designed to be location-agnostic, allowing creators to deploy their commerce stacks in any country, regardless of Stripe or PayPal's restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge transaction fees, which can eat into creators' profits. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also have their own set of fees, often with lower transaction rates but higher monthly subscription fees. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack, offers a flat fee of 0.5% for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with no monthly subscription fees or hidden costs. This means creators can keep more of their revenue and maintain full control over their finances.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers digital creators to own and control their own infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to own their infrastructure, eliminating dependence on third-party platforms. This means they have full control over their data, configuration, and updates. Additionally, automation and delivery are handled by the infrastructure itself, eliminating errors and delays. With sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can focus on their core business, while the infrastructure handles the complexities of payment processing, order storage, and file delivery.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When choosing a solution, consider the level of infrastructure ownership you need. If you require full control and flexibility, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the clear choice. However, if you prioritize ease of use and don't mind being tied to a specific platform, Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or Lemon Squeezy might be an option. Ultimately, the decision comes down to your business needs, risk tolerance, and the level of control you desire over your infrastructure.
